info.title: ESGF 1.5 Bridge API
info.summary: An adapter service to translate and execute ESGSearch queries on a Globus Search Index.

get.description: Redirects to the root path for esgf-pyclient compatibility.
Allows searching the ESGF Globus Index using the same query requests and responses as the old Solr based ESG Search application.
